insights.concise_text: Because contextualised models cannot be evaluated on static tasks, the authors used WSD with Senseval-3 for English and RUSSE'18 for Russian to compare ELMo trained before and after lemmatization.

triple.subject: word sense disambiguation in context (WSD)
triple.object: Senseval-3 and RUSSE'18

insights.concise_text: The RUSSE'18 dataset's 132 distinct forms for 18 target nouns versus Senseval-3's 39 distinct forms for 20 target nouns supports the observed Russian-specific ELMo lemma advantage.

triple.subject: RUSSE'18 morphological complexity
triple.object: ELMo (target) on lemmas outperforming ELMo on tokens for Russian

insights.concise_text: The authors' ELMo models trained on corpora tokenized and lemmatized with UDPipe were evaluated on WSD datasets pre-processed the same way, producing lemmatized and non-lemmatized versions.

triple.subject: UDPipe pre-processing
triple.object: both ELMo training corpora and WSD datasets

insights.concise_text: The widely believed assumption that lemmatization is unnecessary is contradicted for Russian by ELMo (target) on lemmas outperforming ELMo on tokens in WSD.

triple.subject: Russian ELMo WSD results
triple.object: the assumption that lemmatization is not necessary

insights.concise_text: The negligible English ELMo differences and small but significant Russian improvement jointly support the conclusion that language morphology changes whether lemmatized training data helps WSD.

triple.subject: English and Russian ELMo WSD comparisons
triple.object: different decisions being optimal or sub-optimal at the stage of deep learning models training

insights.concise_text: The Russian lemma-based improvement is mostly driven by 3 of 18 words, qualifying the claim that lemmatization yields small but consistent improvements in the WSD task.

triple.subject: 3 of 18 Russian words
triple.object: small but consistent improvements in the WSD task

insights.concise_text: Because UDPipe lemmatization accuracy is about 96% for English and 97% for Russian, the 24 English lemmas and 36 Russian lemmas from target words indicate results depend on lemmatization quality.

insights.concise_text: The feature-extraction setup using single target word vectors from the ELMo top layer led the authors to discuss only that mode after averaging was not beneficial for WSD with ELMo.
